health.notes: Pre-offer health or disability inquiries unlawful except for reasonable adjustments at interview, monitoring, or genuine occupational requirement.

criminal_record.notes: Spent convictions must not be asked about for most roles; certain exempted roles (regulated activity with children/vulnerable adults) are exceptions under the ROA 1974 Exceptions Order 1975.

ethnicity.legal_basis: Equality Act 2010; UK GDPR Art. 9; DPA 2018 Sch. 1 Part 2 §8 (equality of opportunity)

genetic.legal_basis: UK GDPR Art. 9; ABI Concordat on Genetic Testing

salary_history.notes: Not banned, but discouraged by government guidance for pay-equity reasons.
